trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline ("mean" of full pool) with an "indistinguishable" verdict over the runner-up. The series is close to white noise with unstable model rankings and highly correlated errors (mean 0.891, only 3 independent groups), so a simple robust mean is the right choice and further tuning would chase noise.

action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but its spectrum is near white noise, model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.127), and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.891, only 3 independent groups). In this regime a plain mean of the full pool is the most robust combination: it does not overfit to unstable per-window rankings, does not amplify correlated error, and the 0.002 margin over the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable. Accepting the seed is the correct stopping point.
